question: Will Dario Marešić receive a yellow card vs HNK Gorica on Oct 31, 2026 (reg. time + stoppage only)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Dario Marešić receives at least one yellow card during regulation time or stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalty shootout) of the Hajduk Split vs HNK Gorica HNL Round 12 match played strictly after 2026-10-29T19:05:10.718Z and at or before 2026-10-31T22:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if Dario Marešić receives no yellow card during regulation time or stoppage time of the same match within the same window, or if he does not appear on the pitch during that period.

Clarifications:
- Only yellow cards shown during the 90 minutes of regulation play and any added stoppage time are counted; cards shown in extra time, a penalty shootout, or after the final whistle of regulation do not count.
- If the match is postponed, abandoned, or not played within the window, neither condition is satisfied by that match.
